mutations.name: a-missing-stamp-reads-as-current
mutations._mechanism: Nothing was recorded, so nothing was compared — reporting that as CURRENT is the same lie as an empty scrape reading as `no findings`, which is the defect `GATE: INVALID` already exists to prevent one function up.

mutations.name: edited-content-still-verifies
mutations._mechanism: The entire guard: a PASS goes on standing over content it never saw, which is how 4 of 9 findings on a twice-clean design came from the edits that fixed the previous cycle.

mutations.name: a-deleted-gated-file-is-not-a-change
mutations._mechanism: The verdict was about content that is no longer on disk. Treating an unreadable target as unchanged makes deletion the one edit the stamp cannot see.

mutations.name: stale-does-not-name-what-moved
mutations._mechanism: `STALE` without the file list is a manual diff of every gated document — the recovery cost this stamp exists to remove.

mutations.name: a-failing-gate-writes-a-stamp
mutations._mechanism: A stamp asserts `this content passed`. Recording one on FAIL lets a later readback answer CURRENT over a verdict that blocked.

mutations.name: an-unreadable-gated-file-is-stamped-around
mutations._mechanism: A stamp covering two of three files records a verdict over content the gate never saw, and the readback then compares that fiction to reality and says CURRENT.

mutations.name: only-the-first-gated-file-is-recorded
mutations._mechanism: A cycle gates the design AND the impl-plan; stamping one of them is a half-guard that reads exactly like a whole one.

mutations.name: the-verdict-line-changes-without-the-flag
mutations._mechanism: Every existing caller parses this line. The stamp is opt-in; rewriting the default output would break `h_mad_do_preconditions.py` and every doc that quotes it.

mutations.name: verify-stamp-exits-0-when-stale
mutations._mechanism: A caller reading `$?` cannot tell a live verdict from a dead one — and `$?` is exactly the surface the token discipline exists to replace.

mutations.name: the-stamp-lands-somewhere-nobody-reads
mutations._mechanism: The readback then always answers UNSTAMPED, which is honest but useless: the guard degrades to a permanent cannot-judge that a reader learns to ignore. (An earlier version of this mutation replaced the call with `_unused = (`, which broke collection rather than the property — the harness REFUSED it, correctly, instead of crediting a kill.)

mutations.name: stamp-records-a-basename-so-cross-directory-gating-breaks
mutations._mechanism: reverts the F16 fix: recording path.name loses the directory, so a gated doc outside the audit file's dir resolves to the wrong path (unreadable -> STALE) or, worse, to a same-named decoy inside it (-> false CURRENT).
